note: Template CI hosts configuration for MarsCode ship-queue. Copy to ~/.local/lib/marscode/ci-hosts.json and customize for your environment.

typescript.install: t="$HOME/.local/share/ship-queue-ci"; [ "$("$t/npm/bin/tsc" --version 2>/dev/null | grep -o '[0-9][0-9.]*' | head -1)" = 5.9.3 ] || npm install -g --prefix "$t/npm" typescript@5.9.3

node.note: Node release installed by an admin or via infra/ci-host/ci-node.sh

vp.note: Vite+ CLI installed via infra/ci-host/ci-vp.sh; replace placeholder hashes with release checksums

cargo.install: if command -v rustup >/dev/null; then rustup update stable; else curl -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --no-modify-path --profile minimal; fi

shellcheck.install: v=0.11.0; case "$(uname -sm)" in 'Linux x86_64') a=linux.x86_64 ;; 'Darwin arm64') a=darwin.aarch64 ;; *) echo "shellcheck: no release for $(uname -sm)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; t=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$t"' EXIT; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/releases/download/v$v/shellcheck-v$v.$a.tar.xz" | tar -xJ -C "$t"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; install -m 0755 "$t/shellcheck-v$v/shellcheck" "$HOME/.local/bin/shellcheck"

uv.probe: p=$(UV_PYTHON_PREFERENCE=only-managed UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never uv python find 3.12 2>/dev/null) && [ -x "$p" ] && [ "$("$p" -c "import sys, sqlite3; print(sys.version.split()[0], sqlite3.sqlite_version)" 2>/dev/null)" = "3.12.15 3.53.1" ] && d=$(uv python dir 2>/dev/null) && d=$(cd "$d" && pwd -P) && case "$("$p" -c "import sys; print(sys.base_prefix)" 2>/dev/null)" in "$d"/cpython-3.12.15-*) ;; *) false ;; esac && uv --version
